name: SteamOS Remote
author: Hung Vo
description: Discover and control a paired SteamOS host from the Omarchy bar: check status, wake, suspend, restart, or shut down the host, recover its display, manage Gaming Mode display order when supported, and show Sunshine recovery only when host monitoring is enabled.

barWidget.description: Discover and control a paired SteamOS host for status, automatic wake setup, power controls, display recovery, Gaming Mode display order when supported, and optional Sunshine recovery.
